description: This file is a Java Spring MVC controller class managing customer options in an admin context. It provides endpoints for listing, editing, creating, saving, paginating, and deleting customer options, handling web requests and responses, and interacting with services and models related to customer options.

classes.name: CustomerOptionsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller handling admin operations for customer options, including listing, editing, creation, saving, pagination, and deletion.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Handles GET request to display the list of customer options.

methods.name: displayOptionEdit
methods.description: Handles GET request to display a specific customer option for editing based on provided ID.

methods.name: displayOptionCreate
methods.description: Handles GET request to initialize a new customer option creation form.

methods.name: displayOption
methods.description: Prepares and returns the view for creating or editing a customer option based on the presence of an ID.

methods.name: saveOption
methods.description: Handles POST request to save or update a customer option, with validation.

methods.name: pageOptions
methods.description: Handles POST request to fetch a paginated list of customer options in JSON format.

methods.name: deleteOption
methods.description: Handles POST request to delete a specified customer option via AJAX.
